title: Card Security Guideline: Lost, Stolen and Suspended Cartwise Gift Cards
content:
A Cartwise Gift Cards card reported lost or stolen is suspended at once on every card type whose loss report suspends the card at once, and the balance left at the moment of the report is protected. The card-type settings named below are those of the card security schedule.

## 1. Suspension and protection

1.1 A card reported lost or stolen is suspended at once where the card type's loss report suspends the card at once; the card moves from active to suspended.

1.2 The balance left on the card at the moment of the report is protected. The balance is protected from the moment the card type's setting names, which is the time of the loss report.

1.3 A suspension for fraud review is targeted for decision within the card type's fraud review target in business days. A suspended card returns to active when the report is withdrawn or the review clears the card.

## 2. Replacement

2.1 Only a suspended card can be replaced. Whether the card is suspended is read from the company's record of that card before the replacement.

2.2 A suspended card is replaced only when the card was registered before the loss report, where the card type requires registration, or on the purchase receipt, where the card type requires the purchase receipt.

2.3 A replacement costs the card type's replacement fee, taken from the balance: the fee is taken from the protected balance.

2.4 A card is replaced no more than the card type's number of replacements per calendar year. The count covers the replacements dated in the calendar year, across the card and the cards it replaced.

2.5 The replacement card receives the protected balance less the replacement fee. Bonus value moves with it only before its bonus expiry.

2.6 On replacement the suspended card is closed as replaced, and its balance moves to the replacement card as a transfer out of the old card and into the new one.

## 3. Withdrawal of a report

3.1 A report withdrawn by the holder reinstates the card: the card returns from suspended to active.

## 4. Registration

4.1 Where the card type makes registration available, the holder may register the card to their profile.

4.2 A card may be registered to a profile other than the purchaser's only where the card type is transferable between profiles.

## Replacement arithmetic (hypothetical inputs)

| Protected balance at the report | Replacement fee of the card type | Amount the replacement receives |
|---|---|---|
| 45.00 | 5.00 | 40.00 (45.00 less 5.00) |
| 45.00 | 0.00 | 45.00 |

## Replacement count (hypothetical inputs)

A suspended card was itself issued this calendar year as the replacement of an earlier card, so one replacement dated this year already stands across the card and the card it replaced.

| Replacements per calendar year for the card type | Replacements already counted this year | Another replacement this year within the allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | No — the allowance is used |
| 2 | 1 | Yes — it would be the second |
| 3 | 1 | Yes — it would be the second |

## Bonus value in a replacement (hypothetical inputs)

A suspended card carries protected bonus value. If the replacement takes place before the bonus expiry, the bonus value moves with the balance; if the bonus has already expired, it does not move.
